newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek FRNs firm, depos, forwards hold, ecu/drs dips.
newsitem.headline: Greek FRNs firm, depos, forwards hold, ecu/drs dips.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were little changed in late dealings, non-taxable FRNs were gaining ground and ecu/drachma was softer and could even head lower on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Depos and forex forwards are holding but for a 10 basis point spike in the implied tomnext (tomorrow/next) drachma rate," a dealer at a private bank said.
Non-taxable FRNs gained more ground and fixed coupon bonds were steady but trading volume was still low, dealers said.

Ecu/drachma was trading lower around 307.27/33 in late dealings on the back of some ecu selling for drachmas from abroad after hitting an intra-day high of 307.52 and dealers said they expected the drachma to strengthen more on Wednesday.

"I expect massive ecu selling tomorrow as investors rush to take advantage of swap pips in view of the Orthodox Easter and May 1 holidays," said Panos Panayiotopoulos, assistant treasurer at private Alpha Credit Bank .
Ecu/drachma would settle just above 307 and could even breach it on the dowside, added Panayiotopoulos.
Orthodox Easter is next week and Greek markets are closed on Good Friday.
The mark was quoted at 157.15/25 from Tuesday's 157.185 fix, the dollar at 272.70/80 drachmas from 272.290 and the ecu at 307.39/49 from 307.450 drachmas.
